description: Generate fully licensed AI music, background music, sound effects, and video soundtracks from a simple prompt or a public video link. Sonilo can match audio to your video, keep speech clear, mix music or sound effects into a new video, and automatically lower background music under voiceovers. Use it for social videos, product demos, podcasts, ads, games, presentations, and more.

defaultPrompt: Create 15 seconds of upbeat lo-fi music for a product demo.
Create a cinematic 3-second whoosh sound effect.
Score this video, preserve speech, return a new video: https://cdn.sonilo.com/temp/sonilo-openai-review-source-v1.mp4
